claims.text: Headline: US blockades Iranian ports, oil surges
claims.note: CNN (Hanna Ziady) via CNN Newsource, 13 April: US Central Command said on 12 April it would block all maritime traffic entering and exiting Iranian ports from 10am ET on Monday 13 April; Brent rose 7% to $102 and WTI 7.8% to $104. Not ships bound for non-Iranian ports. Headline reworded (comma list).

claims.text: Subheadline: as global markets panic, Peter Magyar's victory offers a rare glimmer of democratic hope
claims.note: Editorial framing ('panic', 'glimmer of hope'). Replaced.

claims.text: According to CNBC, the surge could deepen the world's worst energy crisis
claims.note: No CNBC article with this framing found. The 'worst energy crisis' phrase traces to IEA chief Fatih Birol in early April, not to CNBC on this date. Removed.

claims.text: Potentially catastrophic consequences for global markets
claims.note: No source. Removed.

claims.text: Peter Magyar won the Hungarian election
claims.note: CNN (Christian Edwards), republished by Egypt Independent: Magyar was projected to end Viktor Orban's 16-year tenure as prime minister after Sunday's (12 April) parliamentary election. 'Stunning' removed.

claims.text: The Associated Press reports that European leaders are celebrating Magyar's victory
claims.note: AP story 'European leaders celebrate Peter Magyar's victory in a stunning Hungarian election' carried by AP member sites (Sun Chronicle, WSOC-TV, Telemundo Nebraska), 12-13 April. Full text not read (429/404), so copy keeps to the headline. Anadolu and The National also reported EU leaders welcoming the result.

claims.text: Magyar, a former Fidesz insider, has vowed to dismantle the Orban system "brick by brick", as reported by AFP / France 24
claims.note: AFP profile of 12 April, 'Peter Magyar: former govt insider promising system change' (also listed at terradaily.com/afp/260412041222.v4wxinw5.html): he vowed to dismantle 'brick by brick' Orban's whole political system. The quote was seen in a search snippet of the AFP text; the syndicated page was paywalled. France 24 page itself not read, so copy attributes AFP.

claims.text: TOTO will stop taking orders for its system baths due to supply chain disruptions, as reported by NHK World
claims.note: Fukuoka Now, 14 April 2026 (citing KBC News and TBS News Dig): TOTO told clients on 13 April it would halt new orders for unit baths and related products over the supply of naphtha-derived solvents; toilets not affected; no date set for resuming. NHK's own report not found, so copy attributes Fukuoka Now. Causal link to the US blockade is not made by the source and is not in the copy.

claims.text: Takashi Nakamura, a 35-year-old father of two who was planning to install a new bathroom
claims.note: Invented private individual; no source. Removed.

claims.text: Bloomberg reporting a surge of over 10% in oil prices in the past 24 hours
claims.note: CNN: Brent rose 7% to $102 a barrel and WTI 7.8% to $104. No Bloomberg report of a 10% rise found.

claims.note: internal feed metric, not reportable

claims.note: internal feed metric, not reportable

claims.note: AP, 12 April: Vance left Pakistan after talks with Iran ended without agreement.

claims.text: Self-reference to previous edition "SPLASH AND BURN" and Artemis II juxtaposition
claims.note: Rhetorical self-reference, not news. Removed.

claims.note: Reviewer: only an aggregator summary of a Bloomberg video; Bloomberg page never read. Too weak; removed. Previous note: Bloomberg video headline 'State Street Advises Further De-Risking Amid Inflation Threat', 13 April 2026, seen via the AllMind aggregator (Bloomberg page not read); summary names State Street's Michael Metcalfe. Copy keeps to the headline.

claims.text: Dehd's "Full Performance (Live on KEXP)"
claims.note: playlist/video pick, not news

claims.text: As reported by the Associated Press, Magyar has vowed to introduce a new era of transparency and accountability
claims.note: Two searches found no AP report with 'transparency and accountability'. AP later reported Magyar promising investigative committees into alleged corruption under Orban (infonews.ca, after he took office), which is a different claim and later date. Removed.

claims.text: The Lufthansa pilot strike, set to cancel hundreds of flights, according to Bloomberg
claims.note: Bloomberg (Sonja Wind) via The Star, 13 April 2026: 'Lufthansa's two-day pilot strike set to cancel hundreds of flights'; Vereinigung Cockpit strike from 00:01 on 13 April to midnight on 14 April over pensions, covering the mainline, cargo and CityLine; flights to several Middle East destinations exempt.

claims.text: The airline industry struggles to cope with the fallout from the blockade; the strike could have significant implications for the global economy
claims.note: Causal link between a pilot strike and a blockade announced the day before has no source. Removed.

claims.text: As reported by DW News, the US military has announced plans to blockade Iranian ports
claims.note: Announcement confirmed by CNN (CENTCOM statement, 12 April) and AP via PBS. DW's own report could not be checked (dw.com blocked to the search tool; one further search found no DW copy), so copy attributes CNN.

claims.text: The blockade has been met with widespread criticism and a wave of protests
claims.note: No source. Iran vowed to retaliate against military vessels (AP via search summary), but no protests found. Removed.

claims.text: The blockade will be the spark that sets off a global crisis or a catalyst for diplomacy; only time will tell
claims.note: Rhetorical questions and speculation. Removed.

edits.headline: Oil prices jump on US plan to blockade Iranian ports
edits.subheadline: Brent crude rose 7% to $102 a barrel after the US said it would block shipping to and from Iranian ports, CNN reported.
editorialBody: US Central Command said on 12 April that naval forces would block all maritime traffic entering and leaving Iranian ports from 10am ET on 13 April, CNN reported. Ships travelling through the Strait of Hormuz to and from other countries' ports would not be stopped, it said.
Brent crude rose 7% to $102 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate rose 7.8% to $104, CNN reported.
The announcement came after talks between the US and Iran in Pakistan ended without agreement, the Associated Press reported.

Peter Magyar was projected to end Viktor Orban's 16 years as Hungary's prime minister after the 12 April election, CNN reported. Magyar, a former government insider, had promised to dismantle Orban's political system "brick by brick", AFP reported. European leaders welcomed his victory, the Associated Press reported.

In Japan, TOTO told clients on 13 April that it would stop taking new orders for unit baths because of difficulty obtaining solvents made from naphtha, Fukuoka Now reported. Toilets were not affected, it said.
Lufthansa pilots began a two-day strike on 13 April over pensions that was set to cancel hundreds of flights, Bloomberg reported. Flights to several Middle East destinations were exempt.
